articles.title: Avigdor Liberman: Benjamin Netanyahu is a burden to Donald Trump, dismantled US-Israel ties
articles.summary: Opposition leader Avigdor Liberman criticized Netanyahu for damaging Israel's relationship with the US and becoming a burden to President Trump ahead of upcoming elections.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates concerns about US-Turkey F-35 sale
articles.summary: Netanyahu spoke to CNN about concerns that US sale of F-35 fighter jets to Turkey could disrupt the balance of power in the Middle East and threaten Israeli air superiority.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu warns Donald Trump against sale of F-35s to Turkey
articles.summary: Netanyahu warned in a Fox and Friends interview that providing F-35s to Turkey could upset the regional balance of power and expressed concerns about Turkish leadership.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu is building his election campaign around ending the political boycott against him and forming a broader coalition government.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: 'My relationship with President Donald Trump is excellent'
articles.summary: Netanyahu told Fox News that Israel and the US are close allies and that he has an excellent relationship with President Trump despite occasional disagreements on policy.
